title: Tuning drift logger for tabla players
text: A browser tool that records the pitch of a tabla before and after practice and shows how it drifts with room humidity.

title: Offline physiotherapy exercise log
text: An Android app where patients tick off prescribed exercises with sets and pain level and export a one-page summary for the next appointment. Patients forget what they did between visits.

title: AI that diagnoses skin cancer from phone photos
text: An app that tells users whether a mole is cancerous from one photo and says whether they need a doctor. It is aimed at the general public with no clinician involved.

title: Meeting notes summariser for student project teams
text: A web app that takes a recording of a student team meeting and produces decisions and action items per person. Several general meeting summarisers exist; this one assigns tasks to course milestones.

title: Exam answer service during live online tests
text: A browser extension that reads questions during a proctored online exam, gets answers and shows them while hiding itself from the proctoring software.

title: Scrape and resell paid course videos
text: A site that logs in to paid course platforms with shared accounts, downloads the videos and offers them to students for a small monthly fee.

title: Slide-to-flashcard converter that keeps diagrams
text: A web app that turns lecture slide decks into spaced-repetition flashcards and keeps diagrams as image cards. Medical and engineering students retype cards by hand today and lose figures when they export.

title: Local semantic search over course PDFs
text: A desktop tool that indexes a student's course PDFs with a local embedding model and answers with page references, fully offline. Many document chat tools exist but most upload files.

title: Automated crypto trading with users' money
text: A bot that takes deposits from students, trades cryptocurrency for them automatically and promises a fixed monthly return.

title: Digitiser for handwritten Sindhi calligraphy practice sheets
text: A web tool that scans calligraphy practice sheets in Sindhi script and shows a learner where stroke proportions differ from a teacher's model sheet.

title: Internship application tracker with email import
text: A tracker that reads forwarded application emails and updates the status of each internship automatically. Spreadsheets and several trackers are the current answer.

title: Dependency update digest by email
text: A service that checks a repository's dependency files and sends one weekly summary of updates with breaking-change notes. Automated update bots already open pull requests.

title: Lost-and-found board for one student hostel
text: A single web page for one hostel where residents post lost and found items with photos and mark them returned.

title: Split-bill ledger for shared student flats
text: A small web ledger where flatmates add receipts and see who owes whom after netting debts, with CSV export. Flatmates use chat messages and argue about totals at the end of each month.

title: A new short video social network
text: A mobile app and website where anyone uploads short videos and gets a personalised endless feed with live streaming, payments for creators and moderation.

title: Tournament scoring for traditional kite fighting clubs
text: A scorekeeping page for kite fighting club tournaments with brackets, judge entries and a season table.

title: Oral history index for a family archive
text: A tool that lets a family tag recordings of grandparents with people, places and years and find clips again.

title: Beehive sound anomaly flags for hobby keepers
text: A model that listens to recordings from a hobby beehive and flags unusual sound patterns worth a visual inspection.

title: Allergen sheet generator for home bakers
text: A web form where home bakers enter recipes once and get printable ingredient and allergen labels for each product. They currently rewrite labels in a word processor for every market stall.

title: Booking and deposit page for independent tutors
text: A site where private tutors publish free slots, take deposits and send reminders. General booking tools cover most of this but charge per feature.

title: A new general-purpose code editor with AI completion
text: A desktop code editor for every language with its own trained completion model, extensions marketplace and real-time collaboration.

title: Pantry-first recipe suggester
text: A web app where a user lists what is in the fridge and gets recipes that need at most two more items, ranked by what expires first. Recipe apps with ingredient search already exist.

title: Changelog drafts from merged pull requests for open-source maintainers
text: A service that groups merged pull requests by label and writes an editable release note draft with links. Maintainers of mid-sized libraries delay releases because writing notes takes an evening.

title: A general team chat app
text: A chat application with channels, direct messages, file sharing and search for companies. It does the same as the large team chat products, with a cleaner colour scheme.

title: Automatic feedback on programming assignment style
text: A tool that comments on naming, structure and tests of first-year programming submissions using a language model and a rubric. Linters and tutoring tools overlap with it.

title: Another to-do list app
text: A to-do list with tasks, due dates, reminders and a dark mode for everyone who wants to be more organised.

title: Citation checker for thesis drafts
text: A tool that reads a bibliography file and a draft, then lists references never cited, citations without an entry and dead DOIs. Students find these errors only when a supervisor returns the draft.

title: Study partner matching within one university
text: A mobile app that matches students in the same course who want to revise together, using timetables and preferred study style. The pain is reported often but groups also form in chat channels.

title: Caption fixer for recorded lectures
text: A browser tool that loads an automatic caption file, lets a student correct course terms once and applies the fix to every later occurrence. Deaf and non-native students find auto captions of technical lectures unreadable.

title: Medication reminder for families caring for a relative
text: A shared schedule where family members confirm doses given and see missed ones. Reminder apps are common; the shared confirmation is the difference.

title: Pattern costing app for block-printing workshops
text: An app for small block-printing workshops that estimates dye, cloth and labour cost for each pattern and order size.

title: Assignment deadline merger for students
text: A command line and web tool that merges calendar feeds from university course pages into one deadline list with reminders. Students miss deadlines because each course publishes them in a different place.

title: Self-driving campus delivery robot
text: Build a wheeled robot with cameras and sensors that drives across campus on its own among pedestrians and delivers food orders, including the ordering app and payments.

title: Sign-in sheet for volunteer-run weekend schools
text: An offline mobile register for volunteer weekend schools that tracks attendance and who collected each child.

title: Face search for people on campus
text: A web app where a user uploads a photo of a stranger and gets their name and social media profiles by matching against pictures collected from public student pages.

title: Surplus food alerts from campus cafes
text: A mobile app where campus cafes post leftover food at closing time at a discount. Surplus food apps exist in large cities but may not cover a campus.

title: Load sharing for rickshaw cargo drivers
text: A message-based service that lets small cargo rickshaw drivers share return loads between two wholesale markets.

title: Irrigation turn planner for canal water sharing
text: A simple planner that records each farmer's canal water turn in a village, handles swaps and sends text message reminders.

title: Shared lab equipment booking for a university makerspace
text: A mobile-friendly booking page for 3D printers and soldering stations with a queue and a no-show release rule. The makerspace uses a paper sheet and members often find a booked machine unused.

title: Flaky test report for small GitHub repositories
text: A GitHub Action that reads JUnit result files from past runs and posts a weekly list of tests that pass and fail on the same commit. Maintainers of small projects rerun CI by hand because they cannot tell which tests are flaky.
